tower_n_12: Terran Society For The Protection of Durin People

card_01:
Passive effect: Abyssal Hunter Tactical Equipment limit +3, HP +40%, ATK +20%, DEF +20%

Active effect: View 4 random units from the Preparation Area and choose 0-2 to remove, giving all Abyssal Hunter Operators on the battlefield their classes' Tactical Equipment. If there are no Abyssal Hunter Operators on the battlefield, randomly dispatch an Abyssal Hunter Operator from the Preparation Area instead.
card_02:
Passive effect: All Operators have +15 starting SP; always appears in the deployment waiting zone at the start of battle.

Active effect: Places an [Adaptive Supply Component], providing Transfer Permits equal to the number of operation squad members when its skill is activated.
card_03:
Passive effect: The DEF and RES of enemies affected by Slow, Bind, Stun, Cold, Frozen, or Levitate are gradually reduced, up to a maximum of -50%.

Active effect: Place an [Energy Perturbation Amplifier], periodically applying one of the following negative status effects to all enemies within range (Slow, Bind, Cold, Frozen, Stun, Levitate) for 2.5s.
card_04:
Passive Effect: When a Kazimierz Operator gains Tactical Equipment from another Kazimierz Operator, the retreating Operator returns directly to the redeployment zone.

Active Effect: Deployment Cost for Kazimierz Operators in the redeployment zone is reduced by 5.
card_05:
Passive Effect: Vanguard Operators gain +1 Block; after deploying a Vanguard Operator, immediately transfer 1 Vanguard Operator.


Active Effect: Gives the Operator in the tile in front +40% ATK. If 20 or more DP are remaining, expend 20 DP to increase their ATK by another +40% (max +80% per Operator, not triggered if at max).
card_06:
Passive Effect: When transferring Rhine Lab Operators, all Operators gain 5 SP and a barrier equal to 20% of max HP for 20s. Effect is doubled for Rhine Lab Operators.


Active Effect: After deployment, the next 4 transfers refund half of Transfer Permits used. Transfers of Rhine Lab Operators do not count against this limit.
card_07:
Passive Effect: 'Security Talent Agreement' always appears in the Deployment Waiting Zone at the start of battle


Active Effect: After deployment, the Operator in the tile ahead will gain an additional +4 Transfer Permits for every enemy defeated. While the device is active, Relieving will not retreat that Operator, but rather give them the appropriate Tactical Equipment; while under the effect of this EC Unit, Tactical Equipment that triggers on deployment will have no effect
card_tower_05:
Passive effect: Defender and Guard Operators gain HP +50%, DEF +30%; blocked enemies lose 5% ATK and DEF every 5s, up to 50%

Active effect: Places a [Coating Device Conduction Valve] that grants the Operator in front a barrier equal to 100% max HP (can be charged 2 times) and +2 Block.
card_tower_06:
Passive effect: Whenever an allied high ground unit deals damage to a unit, they gain 5% ATK for 1s. Stacks up to 10 times; duration is refreshed whenever it is stacked again.

Active effect: Place a [Eunectes' Beacon]. Draws attacks from allies. When attacked by your Operators, restores 1 SP to them and increases target ASPD.
card_tower_07:
Passive effect: For each Tactical Equipment of a distinct class that an Operator has, they gain +10% ATK and +0.1 SP recovery rate per second (stacks).

Active effect: Place a [Tactical Equipment Toolbox], giving each Tactical Equipment on Operators in front +1 temporary stack (not affected by Tactical Equipment stack limit) for 15s.
card_tower_08:
Passive effect: Excess healing on Operators is converted to a barrier that lasts 3s (absorbs physical and Arts damage, stacks); Medics heal allied Operators within range for 50% of ATK every 7s.

Active effect: View 4 random units from the Preparation Area and choose 0-2 to move to the Deployment Waiting Zone, and give all Medic Operators on the battlefield the Tactical Equipment of their classes.
card_tower_09:
Passive Effect: Operators on low ground gain 12% ATK and 12 ASPD for every Block being used.

Active Effect: Gain Transfer Permits equal to 4x the total Block of all Operators on low ground.
card_tower_10:
Passive Effect: Operators on high ground gain +8 ASPD for every allied Operator within range.

Active Effect: Place a [Field Support Drone] which periodically loses 8% max HP and restores the HP and Elemental Injury of all allies within range equal to 1.5x the amount of HP lost. [Field Support Drone] can be healed by your Operators and does not retreat due to HP lost.
card_tower_11:
Passive Effect: Operators take 15% less damage from aerial units; always appears in the deployment waiting zone at the start of battle.


Active Effect:
After deployment, choose 1 from 0-4 units from the Preparation Area and add them to the Deployment Waiting Zone. If you choose a Sniper, give all Operators 1 Sniper Tactical Equipment and +1 max equipment level this battle (max +3).
card_tower_12:
Passive Effect: Enemies affected by Cold, Stun, Bind, Levitate or Slow take 15% more damage, or 25% more damage if Frozen; always appears in the deployment waiting zone at the start of battle.


Active Effect: Places [Quick-freezing Sprayer Platform], and for every 10% HP lost, inflicts Cold on all nearby enemies for 8 seconds.
card_tower_13:
Passive Effect: Allies deal 20% more Physical damage. Passive effect doubled when directly behind [Sound Recording Amplifier]. Always appears in the Deployment Waiting Zone at the start of battle.


Active Effect:
After deployment, records the highest single instance of damage taken. When defeated, fires 5 projectiles forward, dealing 100% of recorded damage as splash Physical damage.
card_tower_14:
Passive Effect: Allies deal 15% more Arts damage for every Caster Operator currently deployed.


Active Effect: Inflicts 10%-80% [Arts Fragility] to all enemies in attack range. Effect increases over time.
card_tower_15:
Passive Effect: The further away the enemy, the higher the damage dealt by the Operator (up to an increase of 30%)


Active Effect:
After deployment, transfer 2 random Sniper or Caster Operators from the Preparation Area into the Deployment Waiting Zone; these transferred Operators cost 0 DP to deploy
card_tower_16:
Passive Effect: High Ground Operators have 10% increased damage, take 10% less damage, and have Tactical Equipment limit +1; after deployment, immediately transfer an Operator


Active Effect: Choose an Operator; the Operator in front of the chosen Operator gets +1 of that Operator's class Tactical Equipment
card_tower_17: Passive Effect: Each Sniper Tactical Equipment gives an extra +200 ATK and the ability to ignore 100 DEF.
card_tower_18:
Passive Effect: Specialist Operators can be deployed on both melee and ranged tiles; one extra tactical equipment is copied when a Specialist Operator relieves


Active Effect: Immediately gain 10 DP and transfer 1 Operator. If the Operator is a Specialist, trigger the active effect again. Does not take effect if the Deployment Waiting Zone is full.
card_tower_19:
Passive Effect: Defender Operators are more likely to be attacked, and deal Physical damage to the damage source equal to 100% DEF; Operators gains +15% ATK for each piece of Defender Tactical Equipment

Active Effect: After deployment, all Operators recover 5% of their Max HP per second; whenever a Defender Operator is deployed, gain 8 Transfer Permits
card_tower_20:
Passive Effect: Non-Leader enemies below 30% HP are instantly defeated when Frozen; each time a Supporter Operator is deployed, all allied Operators gain +50 ASPD and +1 SP recovery rate per second for 10 seconds (does not stack)

Active Effect: Deploy an Ice Blast Machine; the machine can be attacked by allied Operators but takes no damage, and uses its skills to inflict AoE Cold, but loses HP over time

tower_n_05.desc: One of Dossoles' under-construction plates was hijacked by a gang of barrens thugs while in transit. It is said that the leader of the gang wants to convert it into an underworld boxing arena. Ms. Candela has tasked you with first teaching the gang a lesson, then inviting their leader to Dossoles for a little chat. She trusts that her sincerity will reach the other party.
tower_n_05.danger:
Danger Level Effect:
Enemies gain increased HP, ATK, and DEF
tower_n_05.hardDesc:
Emergency Supply Condition:

tower_n_06.desc: Recently, the flora of the Acahuallan Jungle has thrived a bit too well, to the point where it is troubling the locals. Inam tasked Gavial with eliminating this creature, and she, ever busy with her medical work, subcontracted the job to Rhodes Island without a second thought.
